# Catalog

* [UX pattern library](ux-pattern-library.md) - Seventeen interaction patterns synthesised from games, configurators, painting and sculpting tools, each with its evidence, its leotard application and the role views it most concerns.

# Domain Concept

* [Consumer garment creators in games and apps](consumer-garment-creators.md) - Four structures (whole-item assembly, template recolour, painting panels, auto-fitting 3D items) and what makes the fluid ones work: few meaningful choices, result always on a body, cheap experimentation, a brief, and a remix loop.
* [Principles for frictionless creative tools](creativity-tool-principles.md) - Resnick et al. (2005) and NN/g reduce 'frictionless' to: direct manipulation with immediate results, trustworthy undo, low viscosity, well-chosen high-level primitives, low threshold with a high ceiling, restraint in features, and pleasure.
* [Dressmaker's build loop - what to take, what to leave](dressmaker-build-loop.md) - The Steam sewing game Dressmaker (2026-09-21) builds a dress in three layers: catalogue parts, a fabric per panel, freely placed decorations. Take those and its free rearrangement stage; leave its missing decoration undo and its manual labour that players modded away.

# Section

* [Interaction design](about.md) - How the editor should feel and behave: the Dressmaker build loop, painting and sculpting tool models, creativity-tool principles and the stone-placement interaction model.

# Technique

* [Single-stone versus brush placement](direct-manipulation-and-bulk-placement.md) - Direct manipulation suits accents but is slow for many objects (NN/g), so stone placement splits into single-click placement that slides on the surface and brushes, paths and fills for volume; a heavy design is 1,500-2,000 stones.
* [Painting and sculpting tool models for stone placement](painting-and-sculpting-tool-models.md) - Reference interaction models for brushes: Substance Painter's recorded, recomputable strokes and 3D paths; Blender's stroke vocabulary (space, drag dot, anchored, airbrush, line, curve, jitter, stabilise); Nomad Sculpt's slide-on-surface insert, curve repeater and mirror repeater; Procreate and Figma Draw.
* [Procedural, editable stone strokes with release to stones](procedural-stone-strokes.md) - Store each brush stroke and its settings and derive the stones from them, so size, colour and spacing stay editable; a 'release' command converts a stroke to individual stones for hand finishing. Acceptance tests come from CLO's rhinestone defects.
* [Sketching panels directly on the body](sketch-panels-on-body.md) - CLO 2026.0 and Marvelous Designer's 3D Pencil turn lines drawn on an avatar into pattern pieces; for a skin-tight leotard this is the natural way to design panels without a pattern window, prioritising how the designer wants it to look over what a cloth solver says.
